s.zh: 苏尔特之焰在体内爆燃，他自己也被严重烧伤。
s.en: Surtur's flame erupted inside him, and he was badly burned himself.

s.zh: 脑髓被神力烧尽：他的大脑永久受损，可以俘虏。夺心魔吞噬这颗大脑能多得
s.en: His brain matter was burned out by divine power: his brain is permanently damaged and he can be captured. A mind flayer devouring this brain gains an extra

s.zh: 他服从了审判，放下武器投降：不再流血，可以俘虏，招募难度减半。
s.en: He submitted to judgment and laid down his weapons in surrender: no longer bleeding, can be captured, recruitment difficulty halved.

s.zh: 黎明退去，他可以被正常俘虏了。
s.en: The dawn receded; he can be captured normally.

s.zh: 巫妖女王收回了她的容器。
s.en: The lich queen took back her vessel.

s.zh: 一道雷劈在他自己身上：存活，但伤得很重。
s.en: A bolt of lightning struck himself: alive, but badly hurt.

s.zh: 只被驱使的野兽安静下来。
\n\n原地留下了神迹残片；全体殖民者心情 +5（3 天）。
s.en: \n\nMiracle fragments were left on the spot; all colonists mood +5 (3 days).

s.zh: 的身体化为灰烬：巫妖女王维拉基斯收回了她的容器，不留尸体，也没有灵魂可以汲取。
s.en: 's body turned to ash: the lich queen Vlaakith took back her vessel, leaving no corpse and no soul to drain.

s.zh: 名吉斯洋基战士从星界跳了出来！
s.en: githyanki warriors leapt out of the Astral Plane!

s.zh: 马拉尔的狩猎号令：地图上
只野兽开始猎杀你的殖民者！
s.en: beasts on the map have started hunting your colonists!

s.zh: 提尔的审判之庭：10格内不能使用任何能力。
s.en: Tyr's court of judgment: no abilities can be used within 10 cells.
